segments.name: Consumer products
segments.description: Sells natural home, beauty and personal care products online through its direct-to-consumer platform.
segments.evidence: We operate an online direct-to-consumer website and mobile application ("DTC platform") where we both sell our Grove-owned brands ("Grove Brands") and partner with other leading natural and mission-based CPG brands, providing consumers a selection of curated products across many categories and brands.

revenueModel.text: Consumers pay Grove for natural household, beauty and personal care products bought through its online platform.

changes.text: The brick-and-mortar retail business was wound down in 2025, following a decision made in October 2024.
changes.evidence: In October 2024, we made the strategic decision to wind down our brick-and-mortar retail business, which was completed in 2025.
